description: This file defines the DoctrineService class within the OrangeHRM testing utilities. It extends the Doctrine class and provides a static method to retrieve the EntityManager, ensuring it is open before returning it.

classes.name: DoctrineService
classes.description: A test utility class extending Doctrine that manages the EntityManager with an open check.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the EntityManager instance, reinitializing if it is closed.
